name: Seat rail cover, outer side
description: Trim cover for the seat rail, existing in symmetrical left and right versions. Selected as the pilot for the symmetrical category of phase 2: a missing piece must be reconstructed from its counterpart and its surroundings.

classification.intended_use: Trim for the seat rail, with no role in retaining the seat or the occupant

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the record, geometry not yet produced

sources.title: 9xxteile - Porsche parts diagrams (PET exploded views)
sources.notes: Confirms the existence of distinct left and right part numbers. No dimension.

post_processing: check of the clearance with the seat rail

titanium.galvanic_isolation: not applicable, polymer interior trim part

known_limits: Left-right symmetry is assumed and must be verified by measurement before any mirroring.
The seat and the rail differ by equipment: variant to be confirmed.
A part obtained by mirroring does not replace verification of the real interfaces.
